methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU's Google AI incubator represents institution-driven capability building in a non-NoVA region, signaling distributed deep learning infrastructure that could spread peer-to-peer if local talent retention succeeds beyond the incubator walls.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Workforce anxiety about AI displacement in Richmond without corresponding upskilling infrastructure suggests shallow adoption pressure concentrated in established tech hubs, leaving workers vulnerable rather than empowered.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia indicates grassroots capacity building in historically underserved regions, testing whether distributed deep learning can emerge from local institutions rather than metro diffusion.

signals.title: Problem-solvers by nature: How Virginia Beach Fire put AI to work - FireRescue1
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach Fire's operational AI deployment demonstrates deep implementation capability in Hampton Roads public sector, but isolated agency adoption without regional knowledge-sharing infrastructure reinforces concentration rather than distributed fluency.

signals.title: Comcast, Appalachian Power continue wrangling over broadband expansion
signals.signal_reading: Infrastructure disputes blocking broadband expansion in Appalachian Virginia directly prevent any AI adoption pathway—neither platforms nor peer learning can scale without connectivity, crystallizing the preconditions for widening gaps.
